evals.prompt: Start a new genomic variant analysis session for gs://my-bucket/samples/patient1.vcf.gz with Firebase auth.
evals.expected_output: Instructions or script generating the Firebase Bearer token and issuing a POST request to /run with the VCF GCS path.
assertions: Retrieves Firebase auth token dynamically via get_firebase_token.py rather than static file lookup
Includes Authorization Bearer header in API request
Sends POST request to /run with the target GCS VCF path
Tracks the returned session_id for subsequent queries

evals.prompt: Check the status of the long-running VEP analysis session analysis-123 and retrieve the clinical assessment report.
evals.expected_output: API query against the status and report endpoints with proper session_id headers and error handling.
assertions: Includes session_id (analysis-123) in status check request
Distinguishes between VEP analysis phase and report generation phase
Parses clinical pathogenicity assessment and population frequency fields from response
Handles waiting/polling gracefully without busy loops
